Method of Attack: Fetching and executing obfuscated code from external sources using techniques like encryption, encoding, compression, and misleading characters
Using a multi-stage execution process to spread malware through malicious GitHub repositories and dependencies
Hiding malicious code within legitimate package files using space-padding and typosquatting
Impacted Systems: Developer systems running Python projects with the compromised 'colorama' dependency
Systems using web browsers, social media platforms, email services, and messaging apps
Attack Vector: Typosquatting to mimic legitimate package names on PyPI
Hosting a fake Python mirror at 'files[.]pypihosted.org'
Hijacking trusted GitHub accounts and using them to commit malicious code
